feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 July 2026 7:28am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 25 July 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at times.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north of Scotland will push weak frontal systems across the area today.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 5 or 6, veering and decreasing West or Northwest 3 or 4 this afternoon in most waters, but still 5 or 6 in the southeast of the area. Becoming West or Northwest 3 or 4 in all waters this evening, then gradually increasing West 5 or 6 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy rain or drizzle.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 5 or 6, gradually decreasing 4 or 5 later tomorrow and overnight into Monday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy rain or drizzle at first, then mainly fair with isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in precipitation.
